verdict.rationale: LegalOS is an AI-assisted immigration case-preparation SaaS, a kind of product that could plausibly offer a test or sandbox environment, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a sandbox, test mode, or isolation from production data. Probes for an OpenAPI spec and llms.txt both returned 404, so there is no developer surface where a sandbox would usually be documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
